title: Event descriptions show as rich text and survive an edit
steps: With -UseFakeData -UseFakeCalendar open Calendar (2) and click tomorrow's 9:30 AM event (its notes are HTML with a link, a list and an ampersand)
Read the notes: the link is clickable and no tags or & show; click it
Press Edit, change one word and Save; reopen the event
Open the 9:30 AM event the day after tomorrow (plain text notes with backslash escapes)
expected: The description shows as formatted text with a clickable link (opens in your browser); tags and entities are not shown. An unedited description is written back unchanged; an edited one keeps its links and lists. Backslash-n shows as a new line and backslash-comma as a comma.
